name: Char
author: Erin Carter
description: The creeping burn-front mapped onto a slowly turning globe: an irregular incandescent terminator sweeps across the sphere's surface, graded hot-to-cool through the palette across its width, leaving a charred hemisphere veined with a glowing ember-crack network and salted with cooling sparks. Virgin surface ahead is dark, lit by a key light and cool rim so the form reads in 3D; the char is painted in object space so it turns with the globe. Staggered burns crossfade while featureless so the consumption never resets.

params.label: Front speed
params.effect: How fast the burn front sweeps across the object.

params.label: Rim width
params.effect: Width of the colour-graded incandescent rim on the surface.

params.label: Spark density
params.effect: Amount of cooling speckle sparks on the charred surface; zero removes them.

params.label: Edge raggedness
params.effect: Scales the FBM perturbation of the front, from a nearly smooth terminator to deep bays and racing fingers.

params.label: Spin
params.effect: Rotation speed of the globe; zero holds it still.

params.label: Zoom out
params.effect: Widens the field of view so the whole globe fits; raise it to pull back and frame the sphere with margin, lower it to fill the frame.
